universal-everything--super-you.why_en: Point the phone at yourself and your body becomes a giant flowing digital being; the whole work is that one transformation.
universal-everything--super-you.why_zh: 用手机对准自己，身体就变成一个巨大、流动的数字生命，整件作品就只做这一次变身。

google-creative-lab--just-a-line.why_en: You can only draw one white line in the air, and that constraint makes spatial drawing obvious to anyone.
google-creative-lab--just-a-line.why_zh: 只能在空中画一条白线，正是这个限制让任何人一看就懂什么是空间绘画。

zach-lieberman--x949953.why_en: A poem is laid out in space, so reading it means walking through it.
zach-lieberman--x949953.why_zh: 一首诗被摆放在空间里，读诗就变成了在诗中行走。

shunichi-kasahara--fragment-shadow.why_en: One body casts several colored shadows at once, turning an everyday shadow into something strange.
shunichi-kasahara--fragment-shadow.why_zh: 一个人同时投下好几道彩色影子，让最日常的影子变得陌生。

shengzhi-wu--sticky-note-from-ipad.why_en: You pinch a sketch and pull it out of the iPad screen like a page from a book, which a child grasps at once.
shengzhi-wu--sticky-note-from-ipad.why_zh: 捏住平板上的草图，像从书里抽出一页纸一样把它拉进房间，孩子一看就懂。

shengzhi-wu--ar-eyedropper.why_en: An eyedropper sucks a color from any real object and squirts it into a lamp, so the world becomes a palette.
shengzhi-wu--ar-eyedropper.why_zh: 用滴管从任何真实物体上吸取颜色，再挤进台灯，整个世界就成了调色盘。

kiyoshi-kiyokawa--visual-noise-reduction.why_en: Noise-cancelling headphones, but for the eyes: moving distractions around you fade to grey.
kiyoshi-kiyokawa--visual-noise-reduction.why_zh: 给眼睛用的降噪耳机：周围晃动的干扰被淡化成灰色。

jun-nishida--handmorph.why_en: Wearing a child-sized mechanical hand makes the real world feel oversized, with no screen at all.
jun-nishida--handmorph.why_zh: 戴上一只孩子大小的机械手，真实世界就显得变大了，全程不需要任何屏幕。

olafur-eliasson--earth-speakr.why_en: Children lend their faces and voices to trees and rivers so the planet can speak.
olafur-eliasson--earth-speakr.why_zh: 孩子把自己的脸和声音借给树木与河流，让地球开口说话。

hart-woolery--yopuppet.why_en: Open and close your hand and a cartoon puppet talks, the oldest puppet trick redone in AR.
hart-woolery--yopuppet.why_zh: 手一张一合，卡通木偶就开口说话，这是最古老的手偶把戏在 AR 里的重演。

irene-alvarado--move-mirror.why_en: Your pose becomes a search query that finds strangers striking the same pose, frame by frame.
irene-alvarado--move-mirror.why_zh: 你的姿势就是搜索词，每一帧都找出一个摆着同样姿势的陌生人。

aidan-wolf--doodlelens.why_en: A doodle on paper peels off the page and comes alive in the room.
aidan-wolf--doodlelens.why_zh: 纸上的涂鸦从纸面上揭下来，在房间里活了过来。

aidan-wolf--hot-potato-lens.why_en: Friends pass a ticking virtual potato phone to phone until it blows up on someone, a party game anyone already knows.
aidan-wolf--hot-potato-lens.why_zh: 朋友们用手机互相传一个滴答作响的虚拟土豆，直到它在某人手里爆炸，规则人人都懂。

luke-hurd--hole-in-the-head.why_en: A hole opens in your head and there is a tiny world inside.
luke-hurd--hole-in-the-head.why_zh: 头上开了一个洞，里面藏着一个微小的世界。

abhishek-singh--musical-chairs-avengers.why_en: Musical chairs where the rivals are life-size virtual Avengers competing for real chairs.
abhishek-singh--musical-chairs-avengers.why_zh: 抢椅子游戏里的对手是真人大小的虚拟复仇者，抢的却是真椅子。

abhishek-singh--tattoos-to-life.why_en: Point at a tattoo and it animates and tells the personal story behind it.
abhishek-singh--tattoos-to-life.why_zh: 对准一个纹身，它就动起来，讲出纹身背后的个人故事。

nexus-studios--notable-women.why_en: AR puts portraits of historic women onto US banknotes, asking who deserves to be on money.
nexus-studios--notable-women.why_zh: AR 把历史上杰出女性的肖像印到美元上，追问谁才配出现在钞票上。

shengzhi-wu--shadow-float.why_en: Move only the shadow and the object seems to lift off the table, showing the cheapest depth cue there is.
shengzhi-wu--shadow-float.why_zh: 只移动影子，物体就像离开了桌面，一眼看出最廉价的深度线索。

lucas-rizzotto--marauders-map.why_en: A parchment Marauder's Map that really shows where everyone in the castle is right now.
lucas-rizzotto--marauders-map.why_zh: 一张真正能显示城堡里每个人此刻位置的活点地图。

lucas-rizzotto--girlfriend-musical-instr.why_en: Every movement of a dancer's body plays a note, so the person becomes the instrument.
lucas-rizzotto--girlfriend-musical-instr.why_zh: 舞者身体的每个动作都奏出一个音，人本身就成了乐器。

tobias-langlotz--chromaglasses.why_en: Glasses that correct color instead of focus, so people with color-vision deficiency can tell confused colors apart.
tobias-langlotz--chromaglasses.why_zh: 这副眼镜矫正的不是焦距而是颜色，让色觉障碍者能分清原本混淆的颜色。

google-creative-lab--drawalong-ar.why_en: A drawing tutorial video floats over your sketchbook as tracing paper.
google-creative-lab--drawalong-ar.why_zh: 绘画教程视频浮在你的速写本上，变成一张描图纸。

zach-lieberman--weird-cuts.why_en: Cut shapes out of the camera image and hang them in mid-air, making a collage in space.
zach-lieberman--weird-cuts.why_zh: 从相机画面里剪下形状挂在半空，在空间里做拼贴。

zach-lieberman--x069317.why_en: A skateboard leaves a trail of words behind it, so a ride becomes a sentence in the air.
zach-lieberman--x069317.why_zh: 滑板身后拖出一串文字，一次滑行就成了空中的一句话。

ishikawa-watanabe-lab--elamorph.why_en: Projected light alone makes a rigid object look as stretchy as rubber.
ishikawa-watanabe-lab--elamorph.why_zh: 仅靠投影，就让一个坚硬的物体看起来像橡胶一样有弹性。

theo-watson--painted-mirror.why_en: A mirror that paints you: the longer you stand still, the clearer your portrait becomes.
theo-watson--painted-mirror.why_zh: 一面会画你的镜子：你站得越久越静，画像就越清晰。

snap-inc--landmarkers.why_en: The real Eiffel Tower melts or sprays rainbows on camera, turning a monument into a toy.
snap-inc--landmarkers.why_zh: 镜头里真实的埃菲尔铁塔融化或喷出彩虹，地标变成了玩具。

daito-manabe--terminal-slam.why_en: Through the glasses, Shibuya's billboards are erased and replaced by music visuals, AR that subtracts instead of adds.
daito-manabe--terminal-slam.why_zh: 透过眼镜，涩谷的广告牌被抹去、换成音乐影像，这是做减法而不是做加法的 AR。

morten-just--kitchen-timers.why_en: Countdown timers float right above the pots they are timing.
morten-just--kitchen-timers.why_zh: 倒计时直接浮在正在计时的锅上方。

marina-abramovic--the-life.why_en: The artist's holographic double performs in the room with you, so a performance piece can exist without the performer.
marina-abramovic--the-life.why_zh: 艺术家的全息分身在房间里为你表演，行为艺术从此可以脱离表演者本人存在。

anrick-bregman--bosch-ar.why_en: Monsters from a 500-year-old Bosch painting walk out of the canvas into your street.
anrick-bregman--bosch-ar.why_zh: 五百年前博斯画中的怪物走出画布，来到你的街道上。

lucas-rizzotto--portal-to-best-friend.why_en: A portal in the wall opens into a friend's home during lockdown, so two people live as virtual roommates.
lucas-rizzotto--portal-to-best-friend.why_zh: 封控期间，墙上的一扇传送门通向朋友家，两人成了虚拟室友。
